body.en:
Question B-001-002-004.

Why the correct answer is right: The certificate must be retained at the station, so it is available as part of the station record.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "must be put on file": A vague file could be anywhere; the certificate-retention rule places the certificate at the station.
- sourceIndex 2: "must be kept in a safe place": Safe storage alone is not the location rule being tested.
- sourceIndex 3: "must be kept on the person to whom it is issued": Carrying it personally misses the station-retention requirement.
